name: VO₂ Max Test
description: A maximal oxygen uptake test measuring cardiovascular fitness. Lab version uses graded treadmill/cycle protocol (e.g., Bruce protocol); field versions include the Cooper test and Beep test.
reputation: Gold standard for aerobic fitness; used in sports science, clinical exercise testing, and epidemiology.
notes: Lab version requires equipment; field estimates have measurement error; age and sex norms available.
